source_title: Airthereal Launches ArcVac Touchless Vacuum Dustpan, Combining Modern Design with Effortless Floor Cleaning
source_excerpt:
Featuring a space-saving design and a 4-liter capacity, the new $129.99 ArcVac Touchless Vacuum Automatic Dustpan simplifies daily cleaning for pet owners by efficiently collecting debris without the hassle of traditional tools.
LAS VEGAS , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Airthereal, a brand specializing in innovative home solutions, announces the launch of the ArcVac Touchless Vacuum Automatic Dustpan , a compact floor-cleaning appliance designed to combine everyday convenience with modern aesthetics. Featuring automatic debris collection, pet-friendly manual operation, and an easy-empty dust container, ArcVac offers a practical alternative to traditional dustpans and bulky vacuum cleaners.
Designed to fit naturally into modern living spaces, ArcVac features a streamlined appearance and compact footprint. Its combination of attractive design and practical functionality also makes it a thoughtful gift for pet owners, new homeowners, and anyone looking to simplify their daily cleaning routine.
Building on the success of its T1 Touchless Vacuum Automatic Dustpan, Airthereal introduces ArcVac as a more compact, design-focused addition to its cleaning lineup.
While the T1 offers a larger 7-liter dust capacity and additional cleaning versatility, ArcVac prioritizes space-saving convenience with a streamlined appearance and a dust container holding more than 4 liters.
Its smaller footprint makes it easier to incorporate into kitchens, entryways, and other living spaces without the bulk of conventional cleaning equipment.
For pet owners, keeping floors free of fur, tracked-in dirt, and scattered litter can feel like a never-ending task.
ArcVac simplifies daily maintenance by allowing users to sweep pet hair and other dry debris directly toward the vacuum inlet, where suction collects them without the need for a separate dustpan.
The device offers both automatic and manual activation modes. While automatic mode provides hands-free convenience, manual mode gives pet owners greater control over when the vacuum operates, preventing curious pets from accidentally triggering the suction.
This flexibility makes ArcVac especially practical for households with cats and dogs, where frequent quick cleanups are often necessary.
ArcVac also addresses a common frustration with vacuum cleaners: removing collected hair and debris from the dust container.
Its convenient dust-emptying mechanism is designed to help prevent hair from becoming trapped during disposal, reducing the need to manually pull out tangled debris.
Combined with its generous dust capacity, this design helps make regular maintenance easier, particularly for households dealing with frequent pet shedding.
The Airthereal ArcVac Touchless Vacuum Automatic Dustpan is currently available for purchase at an MSRP of $129.99.
To learn more about ArcVac and explore its features, visit the Airthereal ArcVac product page .
Founded in 2018, Airthereal develops innovative home products designed to improve everyday living. Its product portfolio includes air purifiers, humidifiers, kitchen composters, vacuum cleaners, and other household solutions. Through practical design and accessible technology, Airthereal aims to help consumers create cleaner, more comfortable, and more convenient living spaces.
For more information, visit www.airthereal.com .
